name: floordrobe-keeper
title: The Floordrobe Keeper: ADHD clothes-on-the-floor mess type
description: The Floordrobe Keeper is the ADHD mess type where clothes live on the floor and the chair. Why putting clothes away feels like a wall, and the first card.

faq.q: Why can I wash clothes but not put them away?
faq.a: Washing is one decision with a machine doing the work. Putting away is folding, sorting, matching, opening, placing and closing, with no dopamine at the end. The last step of laundry is the hardest one for an ADHD brain, which is why the clean basket sits for a week.

faq.q: Is a floordrobe a sign of ADHD?
faq.a: Not on its own. Plenty of people leave clothes out. What is common with ADHD is the pattern: the floor refills within days of every clean-up no matter how motivated you were, because the steps between floor and drawer never got shorter.
